scope: Preview H10/F10 only, three seeds, same original supervised actors and initial calibrated finite-task values as prior temporal model studies. Ten collections, nine train-family episodes each, at most 45000 new control transitions per seed. Latent Gaussian std 0.05, same tanh/residual/servo interface; fixed normalization. Actual finite MC returns, no task-end bootstrap, gamma/soft-survival visitation weights in clipped PPO objective. Full-batch exact fixed-std Gaussian KL checked after every actor step; a step crossing 0.02 is retained and ends actor updates for that collection, not a hard trust-region guarantee. Validation-only iteration selection including zero; final 9400-9402 never selects. No learned transitions/rewards/advantages or input gradients through a world model, no matched quality/compute efficiency or hardware authority claim.
